speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you tell me how long the bleeding and petechiae have been occurring, and do you have any history of easy bruising or family members with similar bleeding issues?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old male. The child's parent reports that the child has been experiencing frequent episodes of nosebleeds and has had several instances of bleeding from the gums. Additionally, there have been occurrences of unexplained bruising and petechiae, primarily on the distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: Has the child had any recent viral illnesses, or is he currently on any medications like aspirin or NSAIDs? I also need to know if he has experienced any severe bleeding after vaccinations or minor injuries.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Frequent epistaxis. I also have Mucous membrane bleeding, Diffuse petechiae on distal extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Platelet_Count
REQUEST TEST: Coagulation_Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Complete_Blood_Count: WBC 6,500 /μL, Hemoglobin 12.1 g/dL, Platelets 280,000 /μL (normal). Coagulation_Panel: PT 12 seconds (normal), aPTT 30 seconds (normal).

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the platelet count and coagulation times are normal, the bleeding is likely due to a platelet function defect or a vascular disorder like von Willebrand disease. Have you noticed any joint bleeding or hemarthrosis, and does the child have a history of prolonged bleeding after dental procedures or circumcision?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant past medical issues. Up-to-date on vaccinations. Social history: Attends preschool. Lives with parents and one older sibling.

speaker: Doctor
text: Does the child's older sibling or any other family members have a history of bleeding disorders, and has the child ever had prolonged bleeding after vaccinations or minor cuts? I also need to know if there is any history of joint swelling or deep tissue bruising.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies any fever, significant weight loss, joint pains, or recent infections.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since the platelet count and coagulation profile are normal, I suspect a qualitative platelet defect or von Willebrand disease. REQUEST TEST: Bleeding_Time
REQUEST TEST: Von_Willebrand_Factor_Assay

speaker: Doctor
text: Since the standard coagulation and von Willebrand tests are normal, I suspect a rare platelet function disorder like Glanzmann thrombasthenia. REQUEST TEST: Platelet_Function_Assay

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Platelet_Function_Assay: ELISA Binding Assay Findings: Platelet surfaces deficient in GIIb/IIIa receptors.
